evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames operational safety and capability as dependent on verification/practice, appealing to conservation (security/stability) and competence (actual capability over nominal assumption).

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnpossessed
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is not actually possessed
mints.frame: Does the speaker justify process or discipline by framing unverified safety/capability as non-existent?
